explanation: Implemented all 11 b09 diagram updates using the pinned sources. The trees separate immutable revision operations, runtime retention, controller publication, and durable persistence; activate presentation settings and row provenance; and add saved-endpoint comparison. Presentation alternatives remain explicitly proposed for b10. All trees fit their existing bounds, all retained attachment labels remain exact and unique, and only the specified new edge is returned.
